description:
## Current scope
SF 10 was measured on 3f8cf88f4a: 78.7 s and 784.8 MB. SF 100 is still unmeasured; no claim that SF 10 remains unmeasured is current.

## Historical finding (retained for provenance)
## Problem
After BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4149 and #4171, FactCashBalances, FactHoldings, FactMarketHistory and FactWatches grow linearly (1,082,320 rows per SF together) and are written by single-threaded Python loops; only FactTrade has a parallel path, and that path now starts only above 100,000 trades, which is SF 0.77. Generation is measured at SF 1 only: 13.7 s and 76,020,843 bytes uncompressed. Two SF 10 attempts through `make heavy-run` on 2026-11-12 were stopped by the watchdog at host memory pressure level 4 caused by other sessions. About 140 s and 760 MB is a projection, and nothing is known above SF 10 although the command line accepts up to 100000.

## Change
Measure generation at SF 10 and SF 100 through `make heavy-run`. If the time is impractical, parallelise the four tables the way FactTrade is, keeping output identical for a given seed across worker counts.

## Guardrails
- Parallel output must be deterministic, as `tests/unit/core/tpcdi/test_deterministic_generation.py` requires for FactTrade.
- A change to generated bytes must change `benchbox/core/tpcdi/generator_specs.yaml` or the algorithm version so cached data regenerates.

## Decision gates
SF 10 is already measured on 3f8cf88f4a: 78.7 s, 784.8 MB. Reuse that evidence; remaining measurement is SF 100. Announce a bounded runtime, disk/memory budget, command and stop condition before lock admission. Measure before proposing parallelism; owner decides whether optimization is worth a generator change.

## Verification rubric
Pass: record commit, generator identity, seed, host, workers, elapsed time, peak process-tree memory, per-table rows and bytes for SF 100, or an observed stop with the actual limiting resource. Projection (about 13 min and 7.8 GB) is not a result. Parallelism, if approved, must preserve per-table bytes/checksums for fixed seed across worker counts.

## Additional guardrails
Use heavy-status and heavy-run only. No foreign-process termination, forced admission or watchdog bypass. Shared-host refusal is not generator failure. Coordinate TPC-DI SF 100 evidence with generator-validation-large-scales-20261111; do not duplicate the run.
